missions.name: Westerplatte
missions.brief: At 04:45 the battleship Schleswig-Holstein opens fire on the Polish transit depot on the Westerplatte peninsula. German assault troops storm the gate. The garrison holds for seven days. Take the five positions in order.

missions.name: Mokra
missions.brief: Dawn. The 4th Panzer Division drives on Mokra, where the Wołyńska Cavalry Brigade holds wooded ridges with Bofors guns, trenches and an armoured train. The Germans lose many tanks before the Poles withdraw after dark. Take the five positions in order.

missions.name: Battle of the Bzura
missions.brief: The Poznań and Pomorze Armies strike the flank of the German 8th Army in the largest battle of the campaign. Poles: fight across the river bridges and drive on the manor. Germans: hold the Bzura until the clock runs out.

missions.name: Siege of Warsaw — Wola
missions.brief: Warsaw refuses to fall. The first panzer assaults on the western suburbs of Wola are bloodily repulsed; the Luftwaffe and heavy artillery pound the city until the capitulation of 28 September. Fight street by street and take the five key positions in order.

missions.name: Starachowice Works
missions.brief: The munitions works of the Central Industrial Region, a showpiece of Polish rearmament, lie in the path of the German advance. Fight through the gate, the rail yard and the assembly halls, take the boiler house and storm the administration block before the plant is lost.

missions.name: Danzig Polish Post Office
missions.brief: Free City of Danzig, dawn. German police and SS Heimwehr storm the Polish Post Office on Rynkowa Street, whose postal workers have barricaded the doors and built firing positions on every floor. Fight room by room: the street, the tenement flank, the main counter hall, the sorting hall and the parcel garage. Take the five positions in order.

missions.name: Modlin Fortress
missions.brief: A nineteenth-century Russian fortress at the confluence of the Vistula and Narew, held by the remnants of the Modlin Army. Thick-walled casemates, brick barracks and an arsenal ring the parade ground behind the gate. Break through the Warsaw Gate, clear the barracks block, seize the arsenal, storm the casemate battery and take the citadel command post.

missions.name: Test Range
missions.brief: Zero your rifle and learn the weapons: static targets at 10, 25, 50, 100 and 200 m, a walking target, and two tanks to test armour, crushing and the coaxial MG. Infinite ammunition.
